# Google Labs

> Google Labs is the home for experimental AI tools and creative projects, offering hands-on experiences with cutting-edge generative AI technologies.

Google Labs showcases innovative AI experiments ranging from creative media generation to productivity automation, with a focus on community engagement and cultural exploration. The platform provides access to experimental prototypes and tools that demonstrate the potential of generative AI across music, images, writing, and interactive experiences.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- AI Experiments
- Creative Tools
- Image Generation
- Music Creation
- Experimental Projects
- ImageFX
- Project Genie

- Productivity AI

- Generative Media
- Design Generation

## Getting Started

- [Google Labs Home](https://labs.google): Google Labs homepage featuring latest AI experiments and creative tools
- [About Google Labs](https://labs.google/about): Overview of Google Labs mission, offerings, and community engagement
- [Explore Experiments](https://labs.google/experiments): Catalog of Google Labs AI tools including Stitch, ProducerAI, and cultural projects

## Creative AI Tools

- [ImageFX](https://labs.google/fx/tools/image-fx): ImageFX text-to-image generation tool for creative AI art exploration
- [Project Genie](https://labs.google/projectgenie): Project Genie experimental prototype for creating infinite diverse worlds
- [Lab Sessions](https://labs.google/sessions): AI collaborations with professionals like Shankar Mahadevan and Justin Tranter

## Productivity & Automation

- [CC](https://labs.google/cc): CC AI productivity agent for Gmail with email briefings and automation

## Community

- [Google Labs Community](https://labs.google/community): Community hub connecting users via Discord, Reddit, X for creative AI projects
